subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The repetitive and __monotonous__ task of data entry made the work seem incredibly long and tedious.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"monotonous"** means dull, tedious, and repetitious; lacking in variety and interest. (नीरस)

 
 
• **Example: **The ***monotonous*** lecture made it hard for the students to stay awake.
 
 
 
• **"Interesting" **refers to something that holds or catches attention, arouses curiosity, or engages the mind. (दिलचस्प)
 
 
• **Example: **The documentary was so ***interesting*** that I couldn't stop watching it.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'monotonous' **is **'interesting'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Interesting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pious **(धार्मिक): Devoutly religious.

 
 
• **Example:** She is a ***pious*** woman who attends church every Sunday.
 
 
 
• **Precarious **(अनिश्चित): Not securely held or in position; dangerously likely to fall or collapse.
 
 
• **Example: **The ladder looked very ***precarious***, so I decided not to climb it.
 
 
 
• **Threatening** (धमकीपूर्ण): Having a hostile or deliberately frightening quality or manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The dark clouds were* ****threatening**** *a storm.
